notes.title: Testers Wanted: Superbot Arena VR!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3266864/8697ecca534d19018ae65935e12feae977851ac8.png[/img]

Want to make a custom superbot and fight others in a VR battle arena? Punch, shoot, sneak, blast and more with custom gestures, abilities and effects in this upcoming multiplayer AND single player game.

[b]I need your help to test it! Free keys will be given in return for feedback.[/b] I reserve the right to disable the key if no useful feedback is provided after a reasonable amount of time.

Inspired by "Super Smash Bros: Melee", "RUMBLE" and "Dragon Fist: Kung Fu VR", supporting different game modes, items, co-op and all sorts of chaos.

If you are interested, let me know in the comments and I'll pick some and be in touch! Thank you!

--> [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/phr00t/announcements]Easy Link for Comments & Showing Interest[/url][/b] <--

- Phr00t

notes.title: ROMBIE hits BETA!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31776673/5054a656d732f55ef10cd30f5cef4465e5cf8714.png[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/745090/ROMBIE/

ROMBIE is on its way to a great release, thanks to all of my private testers! Virtual Reality integration is next. Some of the latest improvements, including many visual ones:
[list]
[*]Higher resolution textures
[*]Post-processing effects
[*]More unique terrain models
[*]Customized terrain shaders
[*]Revamped decoration system
[*]New ability special effects
[/list]
An updated trailer, showing more unique gameplay features & set of screenshots are also on the to-do list for release. When will ROMBIE be released? Still looking at a month or two from now -- I want VR features, and general gameplay, to be polished on day one.

Want to help test? Head over to Facebook to apply:

http://www.phr00t.com/

notes.title: 4/4/2017 Update
notes.content:
Frantic Freighter has been updated! Changelog:
[list]
[*]Updated to 5.4.5p1 Unity engine
[*]Updated SteamVR to latest 1.2.1
[*]Increased player movement speed
[*]Held parts now more closely & quickly track your hand
[*]Added a "crosshair" to more easily select & pickup items
[*]Shrunk map stand to make it easier to move about the cabin
[*]Map will flip to allow being viewed & operated from the back
[*]Moved map forward to make it easier to be used from the back
[/list]

notes.title: Prompt & Engine Update
notes.content:
By popular demand, I've added an "Escape to Quit" prompt when not playing in virtual reality. I've also updated Frantic Freighter to Unity 5.4.3f1, which is the latest stable build at this time.

I've also redone a bunch of the movement & mouse code, which should at the very least be more efficient.
